Disconnect from Bank Feed Provider

If you have connected your bank account to a bank feed provider for automatic bank transaction downloads, you can disconnect by following these steps:

Go to the Bank & Cash Accounts tab and click the View button on the bank account you wish to disconnect.

Then click the Disconnect from Bank Feed Provider button and confirm your choice.

Disconnecting is a useful troubleshooting technique. When you disconnect, Manager will reset the connection details, allowing you to reconnect the bank account to the bank feed provider with fresh settings.
